2609.21075.title: Aligning with Lived Experience: Heterogeneous Benefits of Fine Tuning in Mental Health Support Generation
2609.21075.paper_summary: As access to professional mental healthcare remains limited, many individuals turn to online platforms such as Reddit to seek peer support situated within human lived experience. However, a significant portion of such queries go unanswered, presenting an opportunity for using Large Language Models (LLMs) to fill this gap. While LLMs have demonstrated strong performance on clinical benchmarks, their ability to generate lived-experience informed and community-aligned peer support is underexplored. Addressing this gap, we introduce the COmmunity-centered Peer Engaged Support (COPES) dataset and a three-axis evaluation framework to assess LLM alignment with community perspectives to mental health support seeking queries. Evaluating zero-shot and post-trained (SFT and DPO) models, we show that post-training on COPES significantly improves Strategy Alignment (>50% for general-purpose models) and alignment in Emotion & Tone. However, we also observe that such improvements are heterogeneous and alignment improvements vary significantly across subreddits and requested coping strategies. Furthermore, post-training induces distributional shifts, heavily favoring problem-focused recommendations while suppressing emotion-focused strategies. Together, this work shows that while curating community-driven data improves the alignment of LLM responses, model performance remains disparate across distinct sub-communities and specific mental health needs.
2609.21075.paper_summary_zh: 由於專業心理健康護理的獲取仍然有限，許多人轉向像 Reddit 這樣的在線平台尋求基於人類生活經驗的同儕支持。<lb/>然而，這類查詢中有相當一部分未得到回覆，這為使用大型語言模型（LLMs）填補這一空白提供了機會。<lb/>雖然 LLMs 在臨床基準上表現出色，但它們生成基於生活經驗且與社區一致的同儕支持的能力仍未得到充分探索。<lb/>為了解決這一空白，我們介紹了以社區為中心的同儕參與支持（COPES）數據集以及一個三軸評估框架，以評估 LLM 與社區對心理健康支持尋求查詢的觀點的一致性。<lb/>通過評估零樣本和後訓練（SFT 和 DPO）模型，我們顯示在 COPES 上的後訓練顯著提高了策略一致性（對於通用模型超過 50%）以及情感和語調的一致性。<lb/>然而，我們也觀察到這些改進是異質的，且一致性改進在不同子版塊和請求的應對策略之間差異顯著。<lb/>此外，後訓練會引起分佈變化，強烈偏向於問題導向的建議，同時抑制情感導向的策略。<lb/>綜合來看，這項工作顯示，雖然策劃社區驅動的數據改善了 LLM 回應的一致性，但模型性能在不同子社區和特定心理健康需求之間仍然存在差異。
